cs.t: I don't mean to completely discredit your sentiment. However, I'm making this comment on an MNT Reform. It has served wonderfully as my only laptop for the last year. I'd love to know about equally successful laptops that actually shipped, combining the same set of ideals that were important to me: Open hardware (to a further extent than something like Framework) & tough build quality.
cs.th: Open Source PC That Fits in Your Pocket
